46: // NewController initializes the controller and is called by the generated code
47: // Registers event handlers to enqueue events
48: func NewController(
49: 	ctx context.Context,
50: 	cmw configmap.Watcher,
51: ) *controller.Impl {
52: 	logger := logging.FromContext(ctx)
53: 	triggerInformer := triggerinformer.Get(ctx)
54: 	brokerInformer := brokerinformer.Get(ctx)
55: 	subscriptionInformer := subscriptioninformer.Get(ctx)
56: 	configmapInformer := configmapinformer.Get(ctx)
57: 
58: 	triggerLister := triggerInformer.Lister()
59: 	r := &Reconciler{
60: 		eventingClientSet:  eventingclient.Get(ctx),
61: 		dynamicClientSet:   dynamicclient.Get(ctx),
62: 		subscriptionLister: subscriptionInformer.Lister(),
63: 		brokerLister:       brokerInformer.Lister(),
64: 		triggerLister:      triggerLister,
65: 		configmapLister:    configmapInformer.Lister(),
66: 	}
67: 	impl := triggerreconciler.NewImpl(ctx, r)
68: 	r.impl = impl
69: 
70: 	logger.Info("Setting up event handlers")
71: 
72: 	r.sourceTracker = duck.NewListableTracker(ctx, source.Get, impl.EnqueueKey, controller.GetTrackerLease(ctx))
73: 	r.uriResolver = resolver.NewURIResolver(ctx, impl.EnqueueKey)
74: 
75: 	triggerInformer.Informer().AddEventHandler(controller.HandleAll(impl.Enqueue))
76: 
77: 	// Filter Brokers and enqueue associated Triggers
78: 	brokerFilter := pkgreconciler.AnnotationFilterFunc(brokerreconciler.ClassAnnotationKey, eventing.MTChannelBrokerClassValue, false /*allowUnset*/)
79: 	brokerInformer.Informer().AddEventHandler(cache.FilteringResourceEventHandler{
80: 		FilterFunc: brokerFilter,
81: 		Handler: controller.HandleAll(func(obj interface{}) {
82: 			for _, t := range getBrokerTriggers(logger, triggerLister, obj) {
83: 				impl.Enqueue(t)
84: 			}
85: 		}),
86: 	})
87: 
88: 	// Reconcile Trigger when my Subscription changes
89: 	subscriptionInformer.Informer().AddEventHandler(cache.FilteringResourceEventHandler{
90: 		FilterFunc: controller.FilterControllerGK(eventingv1.Kind("Trigger")),
91: 		Handler:    controller.HandleAll(impl.EnqueueControllerOf),
92: 	})
93: 
94: 	return impl
95: }
96: 
97: // getBrokerTriggers makes sure the object passed in is a Broker, and gets all
98: // the Triggers belonging to it. As there is no way to return failures in the
99: // Informers EventHandler, errors are logged, and an empty array is returned in case
100: // of failures.
101: func getBrokerTriggers(logger *zap.SugaredLogger, triggerLister v1.TriggerLister, obj interface{}) []*eventingv1.Trigger {
102: 	r := make([]*eventingv1.Trigger, 0)
103: 	if broker, ok := obj.(*eventingv1.Broker); ok {
104: 		selector := labels.SelectorFromSet(map[string]string{eventing.BrokerLabelKey: broker.Name})
105: 		triggers, err := triggerLister.Triggers(broker.Namespace).List(selector)
106: 		if err != nil {
107: 			logger.Warn("Failed to list triggers", zap.Any("broker", broker), zap.Error(err))
108: 			return r
109: 		}
110: 		r = append(r, triggers...)
111: 	}
112: 	return r
113: }
